INSERT INTO demo_referral_earnings(referrer_id,referred_artist_id,amount_cents) SELECT c.referred_by,c.id,CASE c.plan WHEN 'professional' THEN 500 WHEN 'growth' THEN 250 ELSE 125 END FROM creators c JOIN creators r ON r.id=c.referred_by WHERE c.membership_status='active' AND r.membership_status='active' ON CONFLICT(referred_artist_id) DO NOTHING

UPDATE demo_referral_earnings d SET amount_cents=CASE c.plan WHEN 'professional' THEN 500 WHEN 'growth' THEN 250 ELSE 125 END FROM creators c WHERE c.id=d.referred_artist_id AND c.membership_status='active' AND d.amount_cents=CASE c.plan WHEN 'professional' THEN 200 WHEN 'growth' THEN 100 ELSE 40 END
